query:
SELECT jsonb_object_keys(reviewed_json::jsonb) as field_key, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM transcriptions
WHERE reviewed_json IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY field_key
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 30;
